banglaExplanation: শুরুতে candidate-কে নিজের কাজ নিজেই judge করতে বলুন।
ভালো feedback specific হয়, শুধু nice job বললে হবে না।
Feedback যত দেরিতে দেবেন, candidate তত বেশি দিন misconceptions নিয়ে থাকবে।
প্রতিটা negative কথার জন্য অন্তত পাঁচটা positive কথা বলুন।

example.bn: ড্রাইভিং টেস্টের পরপরই বলুন: পার্কিং ভালো হয়েছে, কিন্তু আয়না দেখতে ভুলেছেন।
example.en: A driving candidate parks well but forgets the mirror. Tell him right after the test. Praise the parking clearly first.

short.modelAnswer:
I will provide feedback as soon as possible, because:
1. The longer the delay, the longer candidates keep their misconceptions.
2. Delays reduce the relationship between performance and feedback.
3. Candidates can forget what they were thinking during the assessment.
short.prompt: When do you provide feedback to a candidate and why?

cites.quote: Saying "nice job" isn't good enough
Effective feedback should also inform candidate clearly what he/she did well and what needs modification

answer.text: Saying "nice job" isn't good enough. Feedback should inform the candidate what he/she did well and what needs modification.

realQuestions.answer:
I will provide feedback as soon as possible. The longer the delay between
candidates' work and feedback, the longer they will continue to have some
misconceptions. Also, delays reduce the relationship between candidates'
performance and the feedback as the candidates can forget what they were thinking
during the assessment.
realQuestions.label: CBLM 12 Self Check 1 (Q16)
realQuestions.question: When do you provide feedback to a candidate and why?

realQuestions.answer:
Specific feedback helps candidates understand what they did well
and what they need to improve, avoiding vague praise or criticism.
realQuestions.label: Short Questions (answer guide) (Short 35)
realQuestions.question: Why should feedback be specific rather than general?

realQuestions.answer:
Ask candidates to assess their own performance first; identify
positive aspects; give specific praise; and explain corrective actions for
improvement.
realQuestions.label: Short Questions (answer guide) (Short 36)
realQuestions.question: What are effective ways of giving feedback?

realQuestions.answer:
Delayed feedback can allow misunderstandings to persist and
weaken the link between feedback and the work. Candidates may also forget their
thought process.
